decision: Read-only source-risk groundwork. No browser executed; no current runtime defect, completed item159 or acceptance claim.
source_scope: Applied sources only; isolated V13r2 is not presumed applied or tested by this audit.

catalog_save_sequence.accepted: Existing PUT resolves, dirty=false, confirmedReferenceSave=true, then await load().
catalog_save_sequence.successful_read: load GETs own catalog kind, replaces items, clears confirmedReferenceSave, renders, restores focus, then calls saved().
catalog_save_sequence.read_failure: GET503 while confirmed invokes savedReadbackFailure. Try again performs load GET only. Close calls close(), removes catalog and focuses opener without saved(). Unlike createNew unit registry, reference save does not auto-close.
catalog_save_sequence.risk: A confirmed catalog mutation followed by failed own readback and Close can omit a consuming callback. The effect depends on the specific caller and rendered consumer; no universal dependency claim follows.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Catalog list/edit/history only among these rendered files.
kinds.counterevidence: Unit registry campus is input[name=campus] free text; record unit labels/import unit options use returned unit.campus, not campus catalog. Main campus filters derive unit management values. No source-supported universal renamed-campus propagation bug.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Catalog list/edit/history. Profile Roles opens this kind but passes empty callback.
kinds.counterevidence: Profile designation editor is input[data-d][data-key=designation], free text. Identity uses returned member.designations through member-presentation. Catalog rename is not itself a member designation mutation.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Record Leave editor options(): GET catalog/leave_type; render select[name=leave_type] uses active item.key/label. Manage labels callback reloads options and rerenders retained draft.
kinds.other: Leave import toolbar opens initial leave_type; successful callback dirties preview, whose next normalization request can consume updated server definitions. Preview row correction is plain input, not catalog-backed select.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Record Leave editor GET catalog/leave_slot → native select[name=leave_slot] item labels. Catalog Operational meaning maps_to selects supported behavior.
kinds.counterevidence: Main Leave/session text is static leaveTypeLabel(key), not catalog label lookup; do not assert this rename changes existing month row captions.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Record Leave editor GET catalog/leave_status → native select[name=status] item labels. Catalog maps_to controls existing operational meaning.
kinds.counterevidence: Main leaveStatusLabel has hard-coded known labels and titlecase fallback. Renaming a catalog caption alone does not imply persisted approval state or month caption changes.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Record Units editor GET catalog/posting_type → native select[name=posting_type] item labels; mapping creator category posting_label GETs same catalog and renders option.label.
kinds.other: Unit import toolbar opens posting_type; successful callback invalidates preview, but correction fields are text inputs. Main posting labels use normalized call-level helpers.
kinds.strongest_diagnostic: Actual Units→Add posting→Manage labels→switch posting_type→rename existing 2ND_CALL→accepted local PUT→GET503→Close. Inspect still-open select caption/value and unrelated notes/settings; compare explicit GET retry control.

kinds.direct_catalog_consumer: Mapping creator category duty_label GETs duty_type and renders item.label. Catalog owns existing scheduling behavior editor.
kinds.counterevidence: Main mapping options.duty_types comes from getMappingOptions; rota template labels/duty options come from returned template. They are indirect server-returned consumers, not live direct catalog lookups. No scheduling behavior change proposed.

caller_effects.success: options() rereads members/units and consumed catalogs, then render with current draft. Preserves notes/date/id draft, attempts owned focus/selection/scroll restoration.
caller_effects.close_after_read_failure_risk: No options reread; existing item label/active availability remains old. The old stable key is deliberately unchanged; caption freshness and reference authority are the issue.

caller_effects.success: dirtyPreview invalidates stale reviewed state; no catalog choice arrays exist here.
caller_effects.close_after_read_failure_risk: Existing preview may not be marked stale after changed aliases/operational meaning. Requires actual preview diagnostic before calling current bug; changing display label alone is weaker because parser meaning may be unaffected.

caller_effects.success: Empty callback. Existing profile labels derive returned member strings.
caller_effects.close_after_read_failure_risk: No omitted callback propagation effect established.

caller_effects.success: Invalidates Unit cache only; no currently mounted retained parent refresh and no reloadMappings callback here.
caller_effects.close_after_read_failure_risk: Missing cache invalidation alone is not sufficient: services/api global data-sync invalidates Unit cache. Main labels mostly static; no universal stale rename claim.

diagnostic.matrix: Three engines ×320/1280 ×Close/GET-retry; one locally fulfilled catalog PUT per context. Real app navigation/UI, no injected fake UI. Unknown mutations rejected; otherwise-unhandled GETs use RAM8031 only.
diagnostic.selectors: Native input[name=label], select[data-kind], select[name=posting_type], textarea[name=notes] qualified by actual dialogs. Reference catalog stays open after save; recovery Close and retry→Cancel explicit. No assumption of unit-registry createNew auto-close.
diagnostic.source_guards: Frozen local and served source-map hashes before execution, local hashes after. Root must derive a new unique version/report if applied source changes; do not rewrite frozen script or old report.
diagnostic.expected_interpretation: Close case expected-correct assertion may fail on current source, while retry is positive control. Assertion failures must be inspected for actual acceptance, GET503 and final observed caption, not automatically declared product defects.
